subject: Request: short-term hotpatch pool reservation for Helios AI pilot
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term hotpatch pool reservation for Helios AI pilot

Hi team,

Heads-up — Helios AI (pilot account) wants to run a week-long staging sweep next month to validate a bursty real-time reranking flow. They asked if we can guarantee a short, isolated GPU slice to avoid interference with other pilots.

Ask: Can infra carve out a *hotpatch* reservation for 8 A100-equivalent GPUs for a 10 business day window (target window: 2027-04-05 to 2027-04-16)? They need consistent KV-cache behavior for the sweep and we want to avoid noisy neighbor tail latency during the test.

Notes: 
- This is time-limited (10 business days), non-production.
- Helios requests low preemption and predictability more than raw throughput.
- I attached a rough capacity plan and their staging requirements.

Requests from each team:
- Infra (Dev): feasibility, what level of autoscale exception or reservation type is needed (dedicated pool vs. burst lane)?
- Ops (Marissa): operational runbook and acceptance criteria (SLOs to monitor).
- Sales (Ben): commercial constraints, whether we should convert this to a reserved pilot seat or keep as a one-off.

If we can get a quick yes/no and a short runbook, I can loop in Helios and lock dates.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Principal Product Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term hotpatch pool reservation for Helios AI pilot

Lauren — thanks for the details and attachments. Quick notes from infra perspective: 

1) Feasibility: Yes, we can provision an isolated pool for that window, but two constraints:
   - Safety: isolated pools count toward capacity headroom and must not breach cluster SLOs for other reserved customers.
   - Scheduler: creating a short-lived dedicated pool requires a manual carveout and a temporary autoscale-exemption rule.

2) Options:
   A) Dedicated temporary pool (preferred for predictability): carve out 8 GPUs isolated from general pooling. Will require a maintenance ticket and owner.
   B) Burst lane with soft guarantees: cheaper but higher variance — not what Helios asked for.

3) Preemption / eviction: we can set low eviction priority for this pool; that still leaves us the ability to reclaim under severe cluster stress. We can document the reclaim policy in the runbook.

4) Operational overhead: infra needs a named owner and a rollback plan. I recommend Marissa or an oncall from Dedicated Ops to own the window.

I'll draft the autoscaling-exception config and estimate the cost delta. Can you confirm the exact CPU/KV cache footprint per host and whether Helios needs multi-region redundancy?

— Dev
Dev Patel
SRE, Serving Runtime

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term hotpatch pool reservation for Helios AI pilot

Copy — from sales side: Helios is in a pilot PO stage. Procurement contact copied in this thread (procurement@helios.ai). Two commercial points:

1) If we provide a dedicated temporary pool we should attach a small pilot fee to cover reservation costs (pro-rated). Helios is okay with a pilot fee but needs simple terms.
2) If infra prefers burst lane, we should discount or offer credits for any hiccups during the sweep.

I suggest we propose the dedicated temporary pool + pilot fee and include a clause that Helios accepts limited preemption only under declared emergency maintenance. I'll prepare a short-term SOW and send the commercial terms once infra confirms feasibility.

Best — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Ana Ruiz <ana@helios.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@helios.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:01:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: short-term hotpatch pool reservation for Helios AI pilot

Hi Lauren / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming Helios is requesting the 8-GPU reservation for 2027-04-05 through 2027-04-16. Low preemption is important — we can accept emergency reclaim if notified 48 hours in advance.

On sizing: the attachment (helios-staging-reqs.xlsx) includes per-instance KV cache expectations and concurrency targets. We expect 120 qps peak and short 50–150 token responses. Multi-region not required for the pilot.

Happy to sign a short SOW and pilot fee. Please send the SOW and the expected cost delta.

Thanks,
Ana Ruiz
Head of ML Ops, Helios AI

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term hotpatch pool reservation for Helios AI pilot

All — I'm good to own the operational side for the window, provided we get signoff on these items:

- Finalized window (2027-04-05 to 2027-04-16) confirmed by Helios (Ana confirmed above).
- A named infra runbook owner (Dev), and a rollback playbook if cluster stress > 85%.
- A pilot fee to cover opportunity cost; Ben to provide the SOW/price.
- A JIRA for the carveout work (I created INF-9021) and a short runbook doc in Drive (link above).

I will:
- Draft the runbook with monitoring checks (token-level latency, KV cache hit rate, tail P99 latency) and alerting thresholds.
- Coordinate a smoke run 48 hours before the start window.
- Attach a temporary autoscale-exemption policy with explicit reclaim rules.

If we get the SOW and a confirmation from infra on the autoscale-exemption config by EOD Wednesday (2027-03-24), I'll mark the carveout as approved and schedule provisioning.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Dedicated Capacity Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term hotpatch pool reservation for Helios AI pilot

Marissa — confirming infra will produce the autoscale-exemption config and the provisioning ticket by EOD Wednesday. Next steps I will deliver:
- Provisioning ticket ID: INF-PROV-3327 (will be linked to INF-9021).
- Autoscale-exemption JSON snippet and eviction rules attached to the JIRA.
- Cost delta estimate: ~USD 11,200 for the 10 business day window (includes GPU burn and operational overhead).

I'll attach the config to INF-9021 and ping oncall for the smoke run. Once Ben attaches the SOW, we can send the booking confirmation to Helios and begin provisioning.

— Dev
Dev Patel
SRE, Serving Runtime
